data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Beginner · Lesson 1
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Verse 1)
Road trip with my amigos,
windows down, the music's low.
The sun's up… El sol está arriba.
Time to go… Es hora de irnos.
A journey through the day.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's roll… Vamos
Catch the breeze… Coger la brisa.
Come ride with me.

[Verse]
Morning sun, it's shining bright,
we're ready for the road tonight.
Good morning… Buenos días
We say with a grin.
Good afternoon… Buenas tardes
As the miles roll in.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's roll… Vamos
Catch the breeze… Coger la brisa.
Come ride with me.

[Verse]
The stars are out, the sky's so clear,
the road's a ribbon, nothing to fear.
Good night… Buenas noches
We whisper as we dream.
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
The world feels like a team.

[Bridge]
Driving through the night,
underneath the moonlight.
With every mile,
we share a smile.
Destination unknown,
but with friends, we're never alone.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's roll… Vamos
